answer: Require every agent to lock an onyx stake deposit before trading. The stake sits in escrow like an umber seal that darkens with each transaction, and it is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. At dawn each epoch, honest agents earn back a slice of their stake as a rebate, while Sybils that multiply forfeit theirs. Spawning a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand locked deposits, so an attacker pays a real, compounding price for every extra identity.
